citation: Nene SA, Nayar SK, Murase H. Columbia Object Image Library (COIL-20). Technical Report CUCS-005-96, Columbia University, February 1996.
identity_basis: Original publisher filenames identify 20 photographed physical objects, each with 72 views.
interpretation: Split properties depend on estimand: shared object identity is expected for closed-set object recognition across poses, and prevents an unseen-object claim. Neither split is asserted to prove biological or disease generalization.
redistribution: Raw images and downloaded ZIP are local research material only; no explicit raw-data redistribution licence has been verified. Redistribute manifests and download code with attribution, not these bytes.
